title: glandularia sulphurea var. pedunculata
intro: Glandularia sulphurea var. pedunculata, commonly known as Purple Sage, is a perennial herb belonging to the Verbenaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and providing antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Purple Sage include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its overall health benefits and therapeutic potential.
